forwardable_moments.text: We've got AI at 99% accuracy in brain tumor diagnosis. EMJ published it today. And OpenAI’s consumer hardware leap—an AI agent phone by 2027, Yahoo Finance says.

forwardable_moments.speaker: JAMIE
forwardable_moments.text: Exactly. And OpenAI’s move into consumer hardware with an AI agent phone by 2027 is a prime example. Published today by Yahoo Finance, by the way.

forwardable_moments.speaker: RUFUS
forwardable_moments.text: Definitely. And then we have the DeepSeek Claude Code Clone that's gone viral, hitting 8,700 GitHub stars. That's a lot of developer interest, all in a single day. Published today—May 6th again! It's like everything's happening at once.
